Backend: 78/78 pytest passing (62 pre-existing + 16 new admin tests in test_admin_iter4.py). Frontend (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1280x800): app loaded to onboarding/role-select in ~3s with 0 console/page errors and no 'timeout exceeded' error. Captain flow (role-select -> captain -> 9000011111 -> 1234) auto-navigated to /captain/incoming after ~3.5s; mute-btn present, toggles Alerting <-> Muted, countdown decremented (observed 20 -> 15), Accept & Decline buttons visible, no red-screen. Admin flow: role-select shows 3 cards including Admin (dark card). Tapping Admin routes to phone step with 9999999999 auto-filled; OTP 1234 -> /admin dashboard rendering KPI cards (Revenue Today, Commission Today, Total Rides, Active Captains, Total Customers, Pending KYC, Blocked Users, Open Complaints), weekly revenue chart, and 4 quick actions. Navigation to /admin/fleet (map + captain list with 6 online), /admin/users (search + All/Customers/Captains/Pending KYC/Blocked chips + user list), /admin/fares (ZipBike + ZipDelivery cards with editable base/per_km/min/commission + live 5km estimate + Save buttons), and /admin/support (Open/Resolved/All chips + SOS ticket list enriched with user + ride info) all work with 0 errors. Backend admin endpoints verified end-to-end: wrong-phone admin login -> 403 'not an admin', /admin/dashboard returns all 9 required fields, /admin/dashboard rejects customer/captain tokens (403), /admin/fleet returns captains with synthetic lat/lng, /admin/users filters (pending_kyc, search q) work, POST /admin/users/{id}/kyc approves & rejects (rejection resets docs), POST /admin/users/{id}/block sets blocked=true, clears token, and forces subsequent /auth/me to 401/403 ('Account blocked' guard in get_current_user works), PUT /admin/fare-config updates FARE_CONFIG in place and subsequent /fare/estimate reflects new rate (30+10*5=80 verified), /admin/complaints returns SOS list enriched with user + ride, /admin/complaints/{id}/resolve marks resolved=true with resolution note. All admin endpoints reject non-admin tokens (403). No regressions in 62 pre-existing tests.
action_items: None — all iteration 4 items verified. Main agent can proceed. Optional (from previous iteration, still pending): server.py is now 1027 lines (>>700-line threshold); split admin routes into /app/backend/routes/admin.py at next opportunity for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from 752 -> 1027 lines this iteration due to admin block. Strongly recommend extracting admin routes + fare-config + seed logic into a separate module (e.g., backend/admin.py or backend/routes/admin.py) before next feature push.

Admin auth is MOCKED (fixed phone 9999999999, OTP=1234) — intentional per spec, documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Should be replaced with real admin auth (username+password / SSO) before production.

FARE_CONFIG mutation via PUT /admin/fare-config is process-local + persisted to db.settings on startup — good. Note: if multiple backend workers run, in-memory FARE_CONFIG will diverge until next request reload; MVP acceptable, but production should read config from DB on every /fare/estimate or use pub/sub.
admin_fleet attaches synthetic lat/lng derived from hash(id) — deterministic and fine for demo, but replace with real last-known-location once captain telemetry lands.
Blocked-user guard is centralized inside get_current_user (`if user.get('blocked'): raise 403 'Account blocked'`) — correct and applies to every authenticated endpoint. Verified via test.
Bug-fix #1 approach (8s safety timeout in _layout.tsx + trimmed icon font map to 2 families + 15s AbortController on fetch in api.ts) is defensive and correct. No 6000ms timeout was reproducible.
Captain incoming (expo-audio + Vibration/Haptics) does not throw on web where autoplay is blocked — verified: 0 errors during captain flow. Mute state and countdown work independently of audio.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (bug-fix #1 load, bug-fix #2 captain incoming, admin login+dashboard+fleet+users+fares+support navigation) — 0 console/page errors

seed_data_creation: Admin user auto-seeded on backend startup (phone=9999999999, role=admin, id=uuid, referral_code='ZIPADMIN'). Test users created ephemerally per test with random 9xxxxxxxxx / 90xxxxxxxx phones. SOS complaints use TEST_help_iter4 message for uniqueness.
